name: water-limit-low-a-deep
description: Enforce Water Height Limits' lower end (test.md): deep water brush size 1 at the middle of low-ground-a.w3x (ground at -1850 world units everywhere, fixtures/we-specs/make-low-ground.mjs): the water level lands at or near the lowest stored level (-2137.6); the editor's Enforce Water Limits is on (we-drive pins it). KNOWN DIFFERENCE (2026-11-14, branch we-specs-e): the editor raises the ground under the brush so the water stays above its lowest level (the clicked corner to -7168 stored for Deep, -7680 for Shallow, with a falling-off ring); Studio leaves the ground and cuts the water at the limit
